extracted.name: Homemade Spanish Rice
extracted.description: Rice is sauteed with onion and green bell pepper, and then simmered with water, chopped tomatoes and spices.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes and green chiles
2 teaspoons chili powder, or to taste
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Saute rice, onion, and bell pepper until rice is browned and onions are tender.
Stir in water and tomatoes. Season with chili powder and salt. Cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, or until rice is cooked and liquid is absorbed.
